messages:
Eve (Streamline): Hey team — onboarding blocked. After our canary deploy, SDK init calls started returning 429 after ~10 successful ones. We use short-lived JWTs (ttl 30s). Any quick checks?

Marco (CS): Sorry — can you share sdk version + a tiny log snippet? Region?

Eve (Streamline): node-sdk 2.0.1, region eu-central-1. Logs: POST /v1/auth 200,200,200,429,429. We also call init from readiness probe.

Tess (SDK Eng): That pattern screams concurrent cold starts + tight retries. Short-lived tokens + readiness-triggered auth will stampede. Quick fixes: remove auth from probes, add randomized startup delay (0-800ms), and exponential backoff with jitter (200ms->5s).

Eve (Streamline): Can you do temporary uplift while we patch? We need to complete onboarding tonight.

Marco (CS): I opened ticket #22910 for a 2-hour per-key rate uplift in eu-central-1. Please patch and attach telemetry.

infra-bot: Support ticket #22910 created for account "Streamline" — action: temporary per-key rate uplift (2 hours) region: eu-central-1.

Eve (Streamline): Pushed the backoff + probe change, redeploying. Will upload auth counts if issues persist. Thanks!

Tess (SDK Eng): Follow-up: we'll add a docs snippet showing safe init patterns for containerized apps.

Marco (CS): Leaving the uplift open for 2 hours; will cancel if telemetry stays green.
